•  

A professional sales experience of minimum 5 years

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

You will mainly support with Internal and External Digital Communications topics: content creation for social media channels and Benelux websites, monitoring of digital media, KPI analysis, communication projects and governance tasks.

As a Corporate Communications department, we are in touch with colleagues from the divisions in the Benelux as well as with colleagues from the Headquarter in Germany, and external partners.

Your knowledge of Dutch and English should be fluent. Basic knowledge of French is a plus as we are working in a multi-language environment.

Your mandate: execution, ownership and results 
You will personally lead the on-site execution of a major industrial project while overseeing several others, with individual projects worth several million euros. Your responsibility extends from site mobilisation and execution through handover and contractual and financial close-out.
 
This is neither a design-engineering position nor a remote project oversight role. You will be close to the work, teams, subcontractors and customers — while maintaining control of safety, quality, deadlines, budgets, margins and contractual commitments.
 Where you will make the difference  
• Deliver on site. Set execution priorities, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and subcontractors, resolve operational issues and ensure safe, high-quality delivery. 
• Protect project performance. Own budgets, forecasts, costs, cash flow and margins; spot deviations early and act before they affect results. 
• Manage contractual complexity. Anticipate risks, handle variations and claims, contribute to negotiations and safeguard customer relationships, including in public-sector projects. 
• Lead and develop people. Guide a team of approximately five to six project professionals, building accountability, confidence and stronger project practices. 
• Create clarity. Use practical planning, reporting and project reviews to turn complex situations into timely decisions — without unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 
• At least 7 years managing complex industrial projects, including substantial, hands-on responsibility for on-site execution. 
• At least 3 years in project management roles, with proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams. 
• Strong financial and contractual judgement: budgets, margins, forecasts, risk, negotiation and claims. 
• A sound technical foundation, ideally in mechanical, electromechanical, civil or industrial engineering; other educational backgrounds are welcome with substantial relevant experience. 
•  Fluent French and English; basic Dutch is an advantage. Experience with public procurement is particularly valuable.  
Above all, you enjoy the reality of industrial sites. You are pragmatic, structured and decisive; you can challenge technical choices, understand their commercial consequences and bring people with you.

jobs.occupation: Junior Data Engineer – Commercial & Support Functions
jobs.description:
• You support the design, development, testing, and documentation of ETL/ELT data pipelines that transform operational data into reliable datasets for BI, analytics, machine learning, and AI. 
• You contribute to the integration of data from commercial & support fonctions systems such as ERP, CRM, marketingplatformen, HR, and other operational applications. 
• You help build data products and semantic models covering topics such as sales performance, marketing effectiveness, financial reporting and HR analytics. 
• You perform data quality checks, investigate data issues, and contribute to maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring, and data lineage. 
• You learn and apply modern data engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and DataOps. 
• You work in an agile environment alongside data analysts, data scientists, IT colleagues, and business stakeholders, gradually developing into a well-rounded data professional.  
You report directly to the Data & Analytics Platform Architect.

 
• You hold a Master's degree in IT, Data, Engineering, or a related field. 
• You have gained relevant experience through internships, academic projects, or an initial professional experience. 
• You have a solid foundation in SQL and Python and are eager to further develop your expertise in modern cloud data platforms such as Azure and Databricks. 
• You are interested in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, testing, and documentation. Experience with dbt or similar frameworks is considered a plus. 
• You are analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how high-quality data supports better decision-making. 
• You are comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently, accelerate learning, and support innovative solutions. 
• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Knowledge of Dutch a plus.

You will be working as a Data Analytics Intern in the Business Intelligence department at Bosch Home Comfort in Mechelen. Your main responsibility will be to further develop and maintain the 360-degree view of our customers, which will be used to steer the departments (Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, etc). You will support in projects and process optimization. You will maintain and harmonize the data present in different applications. Furthermore, you will be responsible for several Sales reports (in Power BI and Excel) and may be asked to conduct several analyses. Additional from these tasks also customer creation in SAP and CRM will be other important tasks to follow up.  

You are currently a student (Data Analytics, Statistics, International Business Management, Marketing, Economical Studies, etc.) and you are interested in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence. You have excellent analytical and problem solving skills. You are curious and have a positive mindset. You are well-organized, can work independently, efficiently and are self-motivated. Good communication skill and solution oriented mindset is must.

You have practical knowledge of MS Excel and Power BI. Fluency in English is mandatory. Good knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

We are looking forward to receiving your application by e-mail in English (please mention the exact title of the position). Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any further questions.

As a Blending Coordinator, you will coordinate the activities across our sites in Antwerp, Rotterdam and Amsterdam. You will join a team of enthusiastic and committed colleagues and act as the key link between the customer and the various departments within the petroleum division. You will be the primary point of contact for several key customers in the sector, ensuring proactive follow-up of ongoing activities and responding to all customer inquiries. When onboarding new customers or launching new assignments, you take the lead to ensure everything runs smoothly.
 
Key responsibilities include:
   
• Maintaining frequent telephone contact with customers and continuously building strong professional relationships.  
• Managing the daily processing and planning of incoming customer orders. You translate these into work instructions for our surveyors and laboratory staff and help ensure their correct execution.  
• Verifying outgoing reports and invoices that are sent to customers.  
• Working closely with colleagues from the sales team and other departments such as inspection and laboratory services, contributing to strengthening SGS's market position. 

 
   
• You have a background in the petroleum industry and/or have become an expert in blending through relevant professional experience.  
• Responsibility and customer focus are your greatest strengths. You set the right priorities, work proactively and are not afraid to take initiative.  
• You are a service-oriented professional who goes the extra mile for customers and always finds practical solutions to challenges.  
• You are dynamic, driven and flexible, with strong self-confidence and excellent communication skills.  
• You have a perfect command of English. Knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager / Business Development Manager Biometrics
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
   
• Identify, develop and win new strategic accounts within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, building relationships from initial prospecting through to contract award.  
• Own and develop a portfolio of key accounts, establishing account strategies, identifying growth opportunities and increasing share of wallet.  
• Build and maintain strong, multi-level relationships with key decision-makers, including Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Data Management, Statistics, Procurement and R&D stakeholders.  
• Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, pipelines and outsourcing models to anticipate needs and position relevant SGS solutions proactively.  
• Drive new opportunities and expansion within existing accounts,  
• Lead strategic customer engagements, RFPs, negotiations and commercial discussions through to successful contract closure.  
• Develop and execute account plans and business development strategies, including target identification, opportunity qualification, pipeline development and revenue forecasting.  
• Actively build your network through industry events, conferences, professional networks and targeted business development activities.  
• Work closely with internal Clinical Research, Biometrics and commercial teams to develop tailored solutions and competitive value propositions.  
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring customer priorities are understood and reflected in proposals, delivery models and commercial strategies.  
• Establish strong internal stakeholder relationships and coordinate cross-functional teams around strategic opportunities and key accounts.  
• Maintain a high level of market intelligence, including competitor activity, outsourcing trends, pricing and customer priorities.  
• Ensure accurate and proactive management of opportunities, account plans and customer intelligence in the CRM system.  
• Contribute to the development of the Biometrics commercial strategy and identify new market segments, services and partnership opportunities. 

Your profile
   
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Business or an equivalent field.  
• You have 8+ years of relevant commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research or CRO industry, ideally combining new business development and strategic account management.  
• You have a proven track record of winning new business and growing strategic accounts, preferably within CRO, Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics or related clinical development services.  
• You have a strong understanding of the clinical drug development process and the role of Biometrics throughout clinical development.  
• You are commercially driven and comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Biometrics, R&D, Procurement and executive management.  
• You have demonstrated experience managing complex sales cycles, strategic RFPs, negotiations and multi-stakeholder decision processes.  
• You are a strong hunter and relationship builder, able to open new accounts while developing long-term strategic partnerships.  
• You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to prospecting, opportunity development and account execution.  
• You are highly networked within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry and comfortable representing the organization at conferences and industry events.  
• You have excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.  
• You are fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Support to “Quality Manager-Europe” in daily business:

 

• Coordinate the development of monthly and weekly Quality report
• Support meeting preparation and presentation development
• Follow up on Logistics
• Liaise with the regional Project & Sales Team in Brussels
• Coordination with Bosch Residents and with the Quality representatives from all Bosch Business Units delivering one of major automobile manufacturer
• New Projects Monitoring & Review follow-up
• Field Parts recovery and follow-up
• Daily Part Recovery observation

You are currently an engineering or international management student with very good computer skills (MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint).

Basic knowledge in SAP R/3 is appreciated. You have very good analytical and communication skills and the ability to work independently, using own initiation as well as a pro-active approach to the issues.

 

You are fluent in English.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.
